name: Royse
description: A weaver with eight eyes and eight arms hidden beneath her human glamor, who shelters Rowan and points her to a castle.

timeline.summary: Rowan stays with Royse the weaver, who reveals her true eight-eyed form and directs her to an ancient castle.
timeline.quote: revealing eight eyes, two chittering mandibles, eight arms hidden beneath her stole.

pages_say.description: A weaver with eight eyes and eight arms hidden beneath her human glamor, who shelters Rowan and points her to a castle.
A weaver whose advice about rest Rowan remembers.
